means: The route a large result takes from its source to the model: handle and view, ranged reads, query and query_ref, reducers such as striping.
Strategy strat-query-1.0: strat-stem-1.0 plus the query and query_ref tools and the result header; a striping arm gets its own id, never an edit.
Questions with known answers over this repo's own ledgers, profiles and catalog, each answer computed by script without a model, fixed before any run.
Kind of read task: lookup of an extreme or single record, aggregation across many records, or locate then act on one part.
A corpus question whose final answer equals the computed expectation under the scoring rule written before the run; the model's own claim does not count.
Prompt plus completion tokens from a session's ledger, summed over its requests, per solved task; unsolved runs are reported apart, never averaged in.
What one experiment arm could read of the data and of the other arm, written down per arm as PROGRAMME isolation requires.
First solve rate and cost of the cheap non-Anthropic models on the read-path corpus under strat-stem-1.0; the reference for later A1 arms.

name: query strategy lowers tokens per solved task
claim: On the lookup and aggregation shapes of the read-path corpus, strat-query-1.0 takes at most 70 percent of strat-stem-1.0 tokens per solved task, with header tokens under 25 percent of result tokens; refuted by the A1.5 canary or A1.7 run.

models.evidence: docs/epics/A1-read-path.md A1.5 thresholds; docs/QUERY.md OQ1 OQ5 OQ14 (branch query-surface); no live arm run yet

name: query strategy holds correctness
claim: Per model, the solve rate on the read-path corpus under strat-query-1.0 is no lower than under strat-stem-1.0 and under 15 percent of its queries fail at parse or validate; refuted if the median over three runs is lower.

models.evidence: docs/epics/A1-read-path.md A1.5, A1.7; docs/QUERY.md OQ1 (the smoke probe in query-probe-2026-11-21 missed the parse target); no live arm run yet

name: drill-in by declared reference
claim: Given a result header that declares get and property interactions, a model uses query_ref for at least half of its follow-up reads instead of re-running the query; refuted below that, and the threshold is proposed before any run.

models.evidence: docs/epics/A1-read-path.md A1.9 flow ep-A1.9-drill-in; docs/QUERY.md OQ9; docs/TENETS.md concern drill-in rate; no live arm run yet

name: stage-0 baseline on the read-path corpus
claim: Each cheap worker model solves at least half of the read-path corpus under strat-stem-1.0 with the data behind a read-only folder tool; refuted if both models fall under 30 percent, which would make the A1 token thresholds meaningless.

models.evidence: docs/epics/A1-read-path.md A1.1; docs/epics/README.md section 8 (stage-0 weakness unmeasured); thresholds written before the run
